mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, created_time, room_code, state, level, description, solved_cnt, `like` FROM QuizRoom WHERE state = 'OPEN' ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, created_time, room_code, state, level, description, solved_cnt, `like` FROM QuizRoom WHERE state = 'OPEN' AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, created_time, room_code, state, level, description, solved_cnt, `like` FROM QuizRoom WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'OPEN'
SELECT q.id AS quiz_id, q.title, q.image, q.level, qqr.quiz_order FROM Quiz_QuizRoom qqr JOIN Quiz q ON qqr.quiz_id = q.id WHERE qqr.quiz_room_id = #{quizRoomId} ORDER BY qqr.quiz_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QuizResult (user_id, quiz_room_id, score, feedback) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quizRoomId}, #{score}, #{feedback})
mapper.update: UPDATE QuizRoom SET solved_cnt = solved_cnt + 1 WHERE id = #{quizRoomId} AND state = 'OPEN'
